title: Private Capilano Suspension Bridge and Grouse Mountain Tour
includes: Luggage Allowance (1 checked bag per person)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This is a fully private Capilano Suspension Bridge and Grouse Mountain experience - designed exclusively for your group and your pace.

Unlike larger group tours, you won't be tied to a fixed schedule or waiting on others. Enjoy a smooth, flexible 5-hour experience where you can spend more time at the places you love and move comfortably throughout the day.

Cross the Iconic Lions Gate Bridge and head into Vancouver's North Shore for two of the region's most famous attractions. At Capilano Suspension Bridge Park, cross the legendary bridge, explore the treetop walkways, and take in views from the thrilling Cliffwalk.

Continue to Grouse Mountain to ride the Skyride gondola, visit the resident grizzly bears, and enjoy seasonal experiences such as the lumberjack show and the Birds in Motion.

A relaxed and well-paced private experience, ideal for travelers seeking comfort, flexibility, and a more personal connection with Vancouver's mountains.
